datedButNotDownload.item: Grand Theft Auto VI Original Score by Justice
datedButNotDownload.note: Album, not DLC, not a patch, not a download

launch.note: Midnight local time in each region (Rockstar Support); first unlock New Zealand 11:00 UTC 18 Nov

codeInBox.note: Retailers from Thu 12 Nov 2026; the code in the box unlocks the preload

preload.eligibility: Digital pre-orders (Standard or Ultimate); game stays locked until launch

ps5.note: Midnight local time, each timezone's own midnight

xbox.note: Single global unlock: 12:00 AM GMT (Mon 9 Nov 7:00 PM ET / 4:00 PM PT; 1:00 AM CET; 9:00 AM JST; 11:00 AM AEDT)

updates.waves: PS5 three waves: 33% at 10:00 UTC 16 Nov, 66% at 22:00 UTC 16 Nov, everyone by 10:00 UTC 17 Nov; Xbox all at once

updates.notes: Official notes published by Rockstar (first for any GTA VI update): crash fixes; weather not changing; autosave; phone calls not triggering, including story and mission content; unable to lose Wanted Level; deadlift bar in the Gym; partners not handing over bags to sell to fences
updates.waves: PS5 three waves over about 6 hours, all by about 16:15 UTC; Xbox all at once
